source_quote: Brachycephalic conformation showed markedly elevated BOAS prevalence.
Brachycephalic dogs had significantly higher corneal ulcer incidence.
Brachycephalic jaw crowding increased periodontal disease burden.
Mesocephalic groups showed moderate orthopedic prevalence.
Atopy prevalence remained stable within mesocephalic populations.
Dolichocephalic dogs with deep thorax had elevated GDV prevalence.
Dolichocephalic athletic lineages were enriched for DCM diagnoses.
Retinal degeneration prevalence was modest but non-trivial in dolichocephalic cohorts.
Otitis burden remained moderate among mesocephalic skull groups.
Heat-related respiratory compromise was common in brachycephalic dogs.
